meta.title: Live Transfer Stats and Usage Numbers
meta.description: Live production numbers for BIShare — a fast, private, no-account file transfer for every device.

hero.title: BIShare, by the numbers
hero.body: Real production data, updated in real time — no vanity metrics.

footnote: Figures are queried live from the production database on each visit. “Unique users” counts distinct transfer senders — the core product needs no account. Downloads began being recorded recently, so that total accrues from here.
footnoteApps: App downloads are first-time installs as reported by the App Store and Google Play, a day or two behind. Active app users are installs opened in the last 30 days, counted without any device identifier.
